integrity: The proof is universal within its stated domain. It reduces core-square divisibility to two exact cross-divisibilities and exhausts every exponent pair with total multiplicity at most five. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns integers with exactly two distinct prime factors and proves only the sharp lower bound \(\Omega(n)\ge6\). It does not classify the full \(\Omega(n)=6\) layer, all two-prime-support solutions, or solutions having at least three distinct prime factors.
title: A sharp six-factor barrier for two-prime core-square divisibility
